| `wo.job.created`                         | `wo.job-create`                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `wo.job.state_changed`                   | `wo.job-transition`                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `wo.job.updated`                         | `wo.job-update`                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `wo.work_order.closed`                   | `wo.work-order-closure`                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `wo.work_order.required_part_recorded`   | `wo.required-part-record`                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `wo.work_order.service_line_recorded`    | `wo.service-line-record`                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `wo.work_order.state_changed`            | `wo.work-order-transition`                                                                                                                                                                                |

Read-only operations that carry no `auditAction` are not silent: `handleOperation`
emits the request log for every call. An audit action is reserved for a state
change or for a read of restricted data, which is why the two rework-cost
operations have one and the ordinary reads do not.
